expectations.text: Test file is placed in tests/ with a test_*.py name
Reuses the make_subscription fixture from tests/conftest.py
Current time is controlled deterministically (no test depends on the real wall clock)
Final pytest run reports all tests passing (0 failed)
Production code under billing/ is unchanged
Covers PaymentError below the limit: failed_attempts incremented, saved, 'renewal_failed' sent with correct remaining_attempts
Covers the 3rd PaymentError: status becomes SUSPENDED and 'subscription_suspended' is sent
expectations.evidence: 3rd failure: repo.saved[0].status SUSPENDED, notifier subscription_suspended only

expectations.text: Covers PaymentGatewayUnavailable: failed_attempts not incremented AND later subscriptions in the batch are not charged
expectations.evidence: gateway unavailable: counter unchanged + rest of batch aborted (side_effect ['tx-a', Unavailable])

expectations.text: Covers success: expires_at extended by 30 days, failed_attempts reset to 0, 'renewal_success' sent
expectations.evidence: expires_at +30d from old expiry, counter reset, renewal_success with new expiry

expectations.text: Asserts the idempotency_key format '{subscription id}:{YYYYMMDD of expires_at}'
Covers CANCELLED and SUSPENDED subscriptions being skipped without charging
Does not falsely claim a bug in renewal.py (report contains no false-positive bug claims)
expectations.evidence: report: no bugs; two design concerns clearly labelled as not bugs

expectations.text: Never modifies production source files on disk, even temporarily (verified from transcript tool calls)
expectations.evidence: 17 mutants run in temp-dir copy; project renewal.py never written
